last_result.summary: Updated Pulsar resource documentation in README and docs/tools to reflect the implemented read-only resource surface, feature gates, URI/template discovery, session requirements, and safety constraints.

lane_history.summary: Added the Pulsar MCP resource framework with pulsar://context and pulsar://resources static resources, namespace/topic collection templates, URI parsing, feature-gated registration, read handlers, tests, and docs.

Extended the existing Pulsar MCP resource framework with cluster, broker, broker stats summary, failure-domain, and namespace-isolation resources/templates, added focused handler and URI parsing tests, and updated resource docs.

Added read-only Pulsar tenant, tenant config, namespace policy, default resource quota, and namespace-bundle resource quota resources/templates, while keeping existing namespace and topic resource templates aligned with feature gates and docs.

Added read-only Pulsar topic metadata, bounded stats, partition metadata, topic policy, latest schema, and schema version resource templates with aligned feature gates, URI validation, session handling, secret redaction, tests, and docs.

Added feature-gated read-only Pulsar subscription resource templates for listing subscriptions, bounded subscription stats, backlog summaries, and persistent cursor summaries, with URI validation, secret redaction, focused tests, and docs updates.

Added read-only Pulsar MCP resources for functions, sources, sinks, packages, and functions worker state, with URI validation, feature-gated registration, bounded JSON summaries, secret redaction, focused handler tests, and docs updates.

Updated Pulsar resource documentation in README and docs/tools to reflect the implemented read-only resource surface, feature gates, URI/template discovery, session requirements, and safety constraints.
